vocabulary.definition: to happen or make something happen sooner or faster
vocabulary.example: The company plans to accelerate the development of their new product.

vocabulary.definition: a country or area under the full or partial political control of another country and occupied by settlers from that country
vocabulary.example: The British established a colony in India during the 19th century.

vocabulary.definition: to go back over the same route that you have just followed
vocabulary.example: We decided to retrace our steps to find the lost keys.

vocabulary.definition: the point or place where something begins, arises, or is derived
vocabulary.example: The origins of this tradition can be traced back to ancient times.

vocabulary.definition: the gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a more complex form
vocabulary.example: The evolution of technology has transformed the way we communicate.
The investigation into the matter is ongoing and no conclusions have been reached yet.
